description: This file contains test suites for the CLI container target handling functions, including parsing arguments, resolving container targets, and executing commands within containers using podman or docker, with various edge cases and environment considerations.

methods.name: parseCliContainerArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract the '--container' flag and its value, returning a structured result indicating success, the container name, and the remaining argv.

methods.name: resolveCliContainerTarget
methods.description: Determines the container target from command-line arguments or environment variable, prioritizing CLI flags.

methods.name: maybeRunCliInContainer
methods.description: Decides whether to reroute CLI commands into a container based on the container target, container runtime status, environment variables, and other runtime considerations, executing the command inside the container if appropriate.

search-terms: test suite for container command execution
